text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has come once again.
After what
happened last year, Gold
Ship is trying to play it
cool this time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But youth is not so easily tamed. Gold
Ship goes
out like a light again and
arrives at summer camp
deep in
dreamland.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
